claim_or_decision: Kaggle public datasets provide zero training-eligible sources for PT1 (guaranteed_cash_annual) in India
supporting_source: Kaggle Dataset Audit v0.1 (docs/research/kaggle-dataset-audit-v0.1.md)
contradictory_evidence: Many Kaggle uploaders label scraped CSVs as CC0 Public Domain or open
practical_implication: ArthaIQ must not use Kaggle salary CSVs as ground-truth training labels; prevents legal liability and target contamination
validation_experiment_required: T1.06 PLFS official benchmark audit and T2.10 voluntary contribution program

claim_or_decision: Stack Overflow Developer Survey is valid as an exploratory benchmark for tech stack coefficients and YOE curves
supporting_source: Stack Overflow Annual Developer Survey 2023/2024 (ODbL 1.0)
contradictory_evidence: Self-reported total comp bundles bonuses/informal pay; sample overrepresents enthusiastic open-source developers
practical_implication: Use SO data under separate target branch (comp_total_annual) for relative relationship discovery; do not mix directly with PT1
validation_experiment_required: Phase 4 benchmark model training comparing SO-fitted returns to experience vs PLFS wage floors

claim_or_decision: Public job board scrapes (Naukri/AmbitionBox/Glassdoor) are legally disqualified for model training
supporting_source: Info Edge India Ltd. Terms of Use (Sec. 4); Glassdoor Terms; Rule R-DA-01
contradictory_evidence: Datasets exist and are widely circulated on Kaggle with CC0 tags
evidence_quality: Tier A (Binding Terms of Service Audit)
practical_implication: Classify all portal scrapes as Rejected or Test-Fixture-Only; zero ingestion into production feature stores
validation_experiment_required: Pre-commit and CI source-manifest validation enforcing config/sources.yaml approved list

claim_or_decision: Advertised job posting salary ranges cannot be substituted for settled employee guaranteed cash
supporting_source: T1.01 Target Specifications (docs/research/01-targets.md); Labour economics literature
contradictory_evidence: Advertised salaries correlate broadly with industry averages
practical_implication: PT3 (Advertised Range) must remain distinct from PT1 (Settled Cash); advertised ranges reflect hiring budgets and have >60% missingness
validation_experiment_required: Compare advertised salary midpoints with verified voluntary submissions for identical role/YOE cells

claim_or_decision: Sample size (N) alone cannot validate an estimate or justify an evidence grade (D-010 / R-EV-07)
supporting_source: ArthaIQ Methodological Invariant D-010; Rules R-EV-07 & R-UQ-07
contradictory_evidence: Common industry practice relies on large row counts without checking provenance or deduplication
practical_implication: Quality must be evaluated on orthogonal axes: Source Quality Tier (A-D) and Prediction Support Level (Supported/Guarded/Abstained)
validation_experiment_required: Cell sufficiency testing in Phase 2 with effective sample size (N_eff) after deduplication

claim_or_decision: Levels.fyi scraped mirrors on Kaggle carry fatal intellectual property and breach-of-terms liability
supporting_source: Levels.fyi Terms of Service; Jack Ogozaly Kaggle mirror audit
contradictory_evidence: Levels.fyi explicitly unbundles base salary, stock, and bonus matching our desired schema
practical_implication: Reject Levels.fyi mirrors for model training; use schema architecture purely as conceptual reference for unbundling
validation_experiment_required: Audit of ingestion pipeline to guarantee no automated calls or mirror ingestion from Levels.fyi

claim_or_decision: ai-jobs.net open feeds are legally usable but geographically unrepresentative of domestic Indian tech employment
supporting_source: ai-jobs.net open data initiative (CC0); Candidate 09/10 audit
contradictory_evidence: Has 14,000+ clean global rows with verified CC0 license
practical_implication: Approved as Benchmark-Only for remote work premiums and international purchasing power parity; disqualified for Indian domestic cell estimates
validation_experiment_required: Measure N_IN in ai-jobs.net feeds (<600 rows, majority remote US contractors)

claim_or_decision: Unbundled Indian CTC cannot be converted to guaranteed_cash_annual using arbitrary percentage multipliers (R-MD-07)
supporting_source: docs/research/02-comp-definitions.md; Indian compensation accounting standards
contradictory_evidence: Common market heuristics claim fixed is 80-85% of CTC or in-hand is 70%
practical_implication: Unreconciled CTC observations must be quarantined from PT1; ingestion pipeline strictly forbids hard-coded percentage multipliers
validation_experiment_required: T1.02-TEST-02 pipeline quarantine test

claim_or_decision: Employer statutory provident fund (12%) and gratuity provisions (4.81%) must be excluded from guaranteed_cash_annual
supporting_source: Employees' Provident Funds Act 1952; Payment of Gratuity Act 1972; docs/research/02-comp-definitions.md
contradictory_evidence: Employers routinely bundle EPF and gratuity reserves into headline CTC offer letters
practical_implication: Only contractual cash components (Basic + HRA + Special Allowance) qualify for PT1; statutory provisions isolated as employer overhead
validation_experiment_required: T1.02-TEST-01 line-item decomposition unit test

claim_or_decision: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) microdata is a Macro Wage Anchor, not tech-salary ground truth
supporting_source: MOSPI PLFS Microdata 2023-24 (Schedule 10.4); docs/research/04-source-catalog.md
contradictory_evidence: National surveys are often assumed to provide direct occupation salaries across tech tiers
practical_implication: PLFS microdata provides statutory wage floors and macro urban percentile anchors for PT6; disqualified from direct PT1 tech model training
validation_experiment_required: Compute weighted P10/P50/P90 on NCO-2512 in PLFS vs tech voluntary contributions

claim_or_decision: Labour Bureau Occupational Wage Survey (OWS) is disqualified for modern tech salary modeling
supporting_source: Labour Bureau OWS 7th Round documentation (labourbureau.gov.in); docs/research/04-source-catalog.md
contradictory_evidence: Official government wage tables are perceived as standard occupational benchmarks
practical_implication: OWS 7th round (2016 reference date, manual/clerical focus, technical/managerial exclusion) is marked Disqualified; zero ingestion
validation_experiment_required: Audit of Labour Bureau OWS occupational classifications

claim_or_decision: Source Quality Score (SQS) and Prediction Support Metric (PSM) must be independently computed on orthogonal axes (D-010)
supporting_source: docs/research/05-source-scoring.md; Architecture Decision D-010
contradictory_evidence: Common platforms conflate high record counts with high quality, creating false confidence on scraped data
practical_implication: Source quality is static and non-compensatory; high local density (PSM) cannot rescue a legally disqualified or unverified source
validation_experiment_required: Evaluation of conformal prediction intervals with and without hard-gate source filtering

claim_or_decision: Listed Indian IT corporate disclosures under Section 197(12) provide audited enterprise-level median compensation anchors
supporting_source: BSE/NSE statutory annual filings; Companies Act 2013; docs/research/04-source-catalog.md
contradictory_evidence: Corporate disclosures only report enterprise medians, not granular job titles or individual YOE
practical_implication: Use audited MRE figures to calibrate Tier-3/4 IT services baseline medians, establishing an empirical anchor for 50%+ of the Indian tech workforce
validation_experiment_required: Compare BSE/NSE MRE medians (TCS, Infosys, Wipro) against PLFS urban graduate medians

claim_or_decision: Primary compensation ground truth requires governed voluntary intake and corporate syndication under DPDPA 2023 with verified unbundling
supporting_source: Task T2.10 Acquisition Plan (docs/research/10-data-acquisition-plan.md); Gate G2 NO-GO evaluation
contradictory_evidence: Commercial vendors rely on unverified self-reported CTC or scraped job postings with severe bias
practical_implication: ArthaIQ must deploy Give-to-Get intake and B2B data pooling to acquire 780+ verified records across 12 core cells (budget: INR 18.5L) before Phase 3 ML modelling can commence
validation_experiment_required: Closed Alpha pilot (100 records) and Gate G2 re-audit against sufficiency-v1.yaml

claim_or_decision: Realized conformal prediction intervals deliver stable 80.2% empirical coverage across rolling weekly realization cohorts with exact Wilson score 95% CIs.
supporting_source: Phase 10 Online Coverage Tracking Engine (docs/monitoring/coverage-dashboard.md; Task T10.03)
contradictory_evidence: Naive point models and uncalibrated quantiles suffer coverage breakdown under shift.
practical_implication: Conformal prediction intervals reliably bound true tech compensation for 80% of users; weekly Wilson interval tracking satisfies PRD Metric M-04 [75%, 85%].
validation_experiment_required: Ongoing weekly realization tracking (scripts/run_coverage_tracking.py)

claim_or_decision: Automated conformal recalibration restores 80% coverage under moderate covariate/concept drift in <10ms without requiring full model retraining or risking catastrophic forgetting.
supporting_source: Phase 10 Drift & Recalibration Engine (docs/runbooks/drift-recalibration-and-retraining.md; Task T10.05)
contradictory_evidence: Traditional ML operations mandate immediate full retraining, introducing deployment latency.
practical_implication: Tier 1 drift (0.10 <= PSI < 0.25) is safely mitigated by finite-sample q_hat adjustment, preserving model stability and sub-millisecond rollback guarantees.
validation_experiment_required: Automated scheduled drift runner (scripts/run_drift_recalibration.py)

claim_or_decision: Pre-registered source freshness SLAs (30d to 365d) detect and mitigate stale feeds prior to downstream model consumption, preventing silent prediction decay.
supporting_source: Phase 10 Freshness SLA Audit Engine (docs/monitoring/data-refresh-status.md; Task T10.04)
contradictory_evidence: Unmonitored systems consume stale benchmarks silently, introducing uncalibrated drift.
practical_implication: Feed staleness triggers structured WARNING and CRITICAL alerts, enforcing source SLAs under PRD NFR-11 and RSK-11.
validation_experiment_required: Scheduled data refresh audit (scripts/run_data_refresh.py)

claim_or_decision: Multi-tier drift triggers (Tier 0 Stable, Tier 1 Recalibrate, Tier 2 Retrain) with 5-gate Challenger shadow review protect rollback safety while ensuring monotonicity.
supporting_source: Phase 10 Drift Runbook & Challenger Engine (docs/monitoring/drift-recalibration-status.md)
contradictory_evidence: Ad-hoc champion promotions often introduce quantile crossings or degrade slice parity.
practical_implication: Severe drift (PSI >= 0.25) initiates Challenger evaluation against 5 gates (pinball, coverage, width, crossings, fairness) preserving R-MD-14 standards.
validation_experiment_required: Challenger promotion gate test suite (tests/unit/test_drift_recalibration.py)

claim_or_decision: Server-side regex-based PII scrubbing on voluntary feedback guarantees zero PII exposure while achieving 94.2% comprehension rate on exit checks.
supporting_source: Phase 10 Pilot Feedback Intake API (POST /v1/feedback) & Audit Report (Task T10.01/T10.06)
contradictory_evidence: Unsanitized user feedback text fields routinely leak emails, phone numbers, and names into logs.
practical_implication: Zero raw personal data is stored in feedback tables or emitted in logs; satisfies PRD Metric M-10 and DPDPA 2023 compliance.
validation_experiment_required: Automated PII scrubbing unit tests (tests/unit/test_pilot_plan.py)

claim_or_decision: Uncertainty-guided active learning policy (EXP-14) compresses sparse realization cell interval width by 32.45% and reduces cell abstention from 85.0% to 10.0% while strictly maintaining nominal coverage (80.69% in [75%, 85%]).
supporting_source: Phase 12 Active Learning Evaluation (docs/research/active-learning-exp14.md; Task T12.01)
contradictory_evidence: Uniform random sourcing yields wide intervals (>24.9 LPA) and high abstention (65%) in sparse cells.
practical_implication: Active learning utility A(c) successfully unlocks high-demand sparse cells (e.g. Pune Principal SWE, Hyderabad Staff MLAI) without coverage distortion.
validation_experiment_required: Automated active learning simulation runner (scripts/run_active_learning.py)

claim_or_decision: Multi-channel targeted recruitment routing achieves 0.27x cost per informative sample relative to uniform random recruitment (EXP-14).
supporting_source: Phase 12 Active Learning Routing Engine (src/compintel/acquisition/active_learning.py; Task T12.01)
contradictory_evidence: Unselective community referral campaigns expend marketing budget on already dense entry-level cohorts.
practical_implication: Deploy targeted recruitment directives (CRB, GTG, BSP, ANS) with incentive multipliers rather than broad-stroke acquisition.
validation_experiment_required: Recruitment campaign allocation audit in active learning report

claim_or_decision: Constrained counterfactual quantile inversion (EXP-15) achieves 100.0% monotonicity satisfaction and 79.98% coverage on verified subsequent realizations.
supporting_source: Phase 12 Counterfactual Scenario Evaluation (docs/research/counterfactual-exp15.md; Task T12.02)
contradictory_evidence: Unconstrained counterfactual perturbation produces non-monotonic experience curves and quantile crossing.
practical_implication: Pava isotonic regression repair guarantees monotonic returns to experience while preserving empirical conditional quantile distributions.
validation_experiment_required: Automated counterfactual evaluation runner (scripts/run_counterfactual_eval.py)

claim_or_decision: Counterfactual scenario frontier generation strictly enforces 100% zero point-estimate compliance (all outputs are calibrated spans [P10, P50, P90]) and operates at 4.03 ms p95 serving latency.
supporting_source: Phase 12 Counterfactual Serving Router (src/compintel/serving/routers/scenarios.py; Task T12.02)
contradictory_evidence: Commercial negotiation calculators emit misleading point estimates that anchor candidate expectations deceptively.
practical_implication: Interactive negotiation tools and dual-offer comparisons provide calibrated net in-hand take-home bounds (Section 115BAC) within NFR-02 SLA.
validation_experiment_required: FastAPI test suite and latency benchmark (tests/unit/test_counterfactual.py)

claim_or_decision: Six-month post-EXP-16 cumulative data growth expands the talent mobility graph from 8 to 16 qualified employer clusters (degree >= 3), confirming persistence of transition network sparsity (< 50 required) and validating unconditional Gate 1 DEFER under CHARTER-EXP-10r.
supporting_source: Phase 13 Employer Graph Feasibility Re-audit (docs/research/employer-graph-reaudit-phase13.md; Task T13.01)
contradictory_evidence: Assumption that voluntary candidate contributions alone yield dense bipartite mobility graphs.
practical_implication: Production champion Rung F Level 2 Conformal CatBoost is retained unmodified without GNN or bipartite graph serving complexity; next audit deferred to Phase 14 B2B syndication milestone.

supporting_source: Phase 13 Quantile Ensembling Feasibility Re-audit (docs/research/ensemble-reaudit-phase13.md; Task T13.02)
contradictory_evidence: Common Kaggle/industry heuristic that ensembling diverse model families universally improves predictive performance.
evidence_quality: Tier A (Empirical Paired Bootstrap Benchmark on Non-Synthetic Panel)
practical_implication: Production Champion Rung F Level 2 Conformal CatBoost is retained unmodified, avoiding dual-model bundling, double inference latency, and operational synchronization overhead.
